```{r}
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)
library(tidyverse)

capture <- read.csv("Data/capture_cleaned.csv")

capture$date <- as.Date(capture$date)
capture$month <- as.numeric(format(capture$date,"%m"))

capture$sex <- as.factor(capture$sex)
capture$age <- as.factor(capture$age)
capture$site <- as.factor(capture$site)
capture$repro_status <- as.factor(capture$repro_status)

ui <- dashboardPage(

dashboardHeader(title="Bat Reproductive Timing"),

dashboardSidebar(

sidebarMenu(
menuItem("Reproductive Timing", tabName="repro")
)

),

dashboardBody(

tabItems(

tabItem(tabName="repro",

fluidRow(

box(width=4,

selectInput(
"site_filter",
"Select Site",
choices=c("All",levels(capture$site)),
selected="All"
),

checkboxInput(
"adult_only",
"Only Adult Females",
value=TRUE
)

),

box(width=8,

plotOutput("repro_month_plot"),
verbatimTextOutput("repro_summary")

)

),

fluidRow(

box(width=12,
plotOutput("repro_site_plot"))

)

)

)

)

)

server <- function(input, output){

filtered_data <- reactive({

data <- capture

if(input$adult_only){
data <- data %>%
filter(sex=="F", age=="Adult")
}

if(input$site_filter!="All"){
data <- data %>%
filter(site==input$site_filter)
}

data

})

output$repro_month_plot <- renderPlot({

data <- filtered_data()

summary <- data %>%
filter(!is.na(repro_status)) %>%
group_by(month,repro_status) %>%
summarise(count=n(),.groups="drop")

ggplot(summary,
aes(month,count,fill=repro_status))+

geom_col(position="dodge")+

scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")+

labs(
title="Reproductive Status by Month",
x="Month",
y="Number of Bats",
fill="Reproductive Status"
)+

theme_minimal()

})

output$repro_site_plot <- renderPlot({

data <- filtered_data()

summary <- data %>%
filter(!is.na(repro_status)) %>%
group_by(site,repro_status) %>%
summarise(count=n(),.groups="drop")

ggplot(summary,
aes(site,count,fill=repro_status))+

geom_col()+

scale_fill_brewer(palette="Dark2")+

labs(
title="Reproductive Status by Site",
x="Site",
y="Number of Bats",
fill="Status"
)+

theme_minimal()+
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))

})

output$repro_summary <- renderPrint({

data <- filtered_data()

summary <- data %>%
filter(!is.na(repro_status)) %>%
mutate(
reproductive = repro_status %in%
c("Pregnant","Lactating","Post-lactating")
) %>%
summarise(
total_females = n(),
reproductive_females = sum(reproductive),
proportion_reproductive =
reproductive_females/total_females
)

print(summary)

})

}

shinyApp(ui,server)
```
